extDescription.message: Hands downloads from the browser over to TUNAS Download Manager.

titleOffClick.message: takeover switched off (click to switch on)

videoButtonTitle.message: Download this video with TUNAS Download Manager

helpConnected.message: Connected – the extension is working with TUNAS Download Manager.

helpNotConnected.message: No connection to TUNAS Download Manager.

helpStepsTitle.message: How to get the connection back:

helpStepInstalled.message: TUNAS Download Manager must be installed. It is started automatically when needed.

helpStepRepair.message: In TUNAS Download Manager, open “Options” → “Browser” and click “Repair”.

helpStepRestart.message: Close the browser completely (all windows) and start it again. Some browsers only notice the program's registration after that.

helpStepRetry.message: Then click “Connect again” here or the TUNAS icon in the toolbar.
